data.name: Greater Chimeric Fiend
data.description: A fiendflesh shifter's chimeric fiend ability grants her additional bonuses as noted below. [Daemon] The shifter gains a +4 enhancement bonus to her Constitution score and immunity to disease. [Demon] The shifter gains a +4 enhancement bonus to her Strength score and increases the damage die of all natural attacks by one step. [Devil] The shifter gains a +4 enhancement bonus to her Dexterity score and see in darkness as per the universal monster rule.
